name: Sapphire Foods India Ltd
title: Sapphire Foods India Ltd - 543397 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: QSR operator (KFC/Pizza Hut) with Q4 SSSG 4% (6% ex-Navratri) and restaurant EBITDA up 110bp to 16.8% on value-led recruitment, but capex and FY27 spend held flat and Pizza Hut still declining.

capex.quote: When I look at the coming year, we see a similar number of capex, similar number in terms of the capex spend for FY '27 as well.

triggers.label: KFC SSSG 4% (6% ex-Navratri)
triggers.quote: KFC SSSG grew at 4%. 6% without the impact of Navratri last year

triggers.label: KFC price hikes 1.5-2% cumulative
triggers.quote: If I add up both the price hikes, it's in the range of 1.5% to 2% price hike for KFC.

triggers.label: Gross margin hit 50-70bp if vendor support ends
triggers.quote: if the vendor partner support goes away, we expect the gross margin impact of anywhere or a gross margin investment of anywhere between 50 to 70 basis points.

triggers.label: Sri Lanka store adds high-single to low-double digit
triggers.quote: we should be able to accelerate store expansion as well as in Sri Lanka, which would be anywhere between, let's say, a high single digit or low early double digits

guidance.metric: KFC gross margin investment if vendor support ends
guidance.quote: we expect the gross margin impact of anywhere or a gross margin investment of anywhere between 50 to 70 basis points.

guidance.metric: Pizza Hut LPG cost impact on EBITDA
guidance.quote: the impact could be anywhere between 25% to 40% increase in terms of the cost, which could impact the EBITDA by 30 to 50 basis point.
we see a similar number of capex, similar number in terms of the capex spend for FY '27 as well.
by the end of this financial year, we should be in a position to consume the merger.

red_flags.label: Pizza Hut SSSG -7%, EBITDA negative
red_flags.quote: restaurant EBITDA decline came in at 6% on account of operating deleverage.

red_flags.label: Margin support reliant on vendor subsidy
red_flags.quote: this particular offer has been also supported by our vendor partners as well.

evasions.quote: So, we have not given out the numbers, but yes, our SS TG has been closer to the SSSG performance
maybe in that case, we can take this question offline.
we are not allowed to share that number publicly to be fair.
